status: SURVEY_ONLY / NOT A WORLD LAW / NOT APPROVED
purpose: Compare candidate discrete laws for turning exact pair impulses into stored per-atom momentum changes when N >= 3. The Gate does not choose a law; the designer does.
grid: momentum profile FX(96,80) (C1-B1 production momentum grid), unit u = 2^-80. Rounding = round half to even (odd-symmetric), exactly as a_numeric.profiles.FixedPoint.
convention: pair (i,j) with dr = r_j - r_i: exact real impulse A_ij acts +A_ij on j and -A_ij on i (C1-B1 convention).

candidates.P: per pair, per component: J_ij = round(A_ij); dp_j += J_ij, dp_i -= J_ij; exact integer sums (C1-C section 6 recommended candidate).
candidates.T: per atom, per component: dp_i = round(sum_j exact signed A) (one rounding of the exact total).
candidates.C: T, then per component D = sum_i dp_i; if D != 0 move |D| units label-free: with e_i = dp_i - a_i, subtract sign(D) from the |D| atoms with the largest sign(D)*e_i (largest-remainder / Hamilton). If the cut falls inside a group of equal e_i: STOP (no label-free choice exists). New candidate written for this Gate (C1-C D4 left coupled undefined).

physics_evaluation: Exact pair impulse enclosures from a_reference/c1b1_two_atom.py (frozen C1-A Lang 2024 model, retardation ON), dt = 40, kick = dt/2 = 20, positions exact rationals on the FX(96,48) grid. P uses c1b1_two_atom.impulse directly. T and C refine the summed enclosure until one rounded value is decided (start 128 bits, double, max 4096 bits for this Gate; beyond that REFUSED). C rank decisions use the same enclosures; an undecidable rank comparison within 4096 bits is REFUSED.

synthetic_panel.named_cases: S_collective (0.4 x3 onto one atom), S_split (-0.8, 0.4, 0.4), S_pair (+0.6/-0.6), S_ties (exact halves), S_many (K pairs of 0.1 onto one atom, K = 1..20)
synthetic_panel.exhaustive_N3: one component, 3 pairs, A in {k/10 : k = -15..15} (29,791 configurations)
synthetic_panel.exhaustive_N4: one component, 6 pairs, A in {k/5 : k = -4..4} (531,441 configurations)

physics_panel.N2_reduction: 6 pairs at R in {6.5, 7.1, 8, 10, 20, 50} bohr along non-axis directions; every candidate must equal c1b1_two_atom.impulse bit for bit
physics_panel.small_clusters: equilateral triangle side 7.0; linear chain spacing 7.5; square side 7.2; regular tetrahedron edge 7.0 (bohr). Coordinates rounded to the FX(96,48) grid once, before any impulse.
physics_panel.far_field: center atom + 8 atoms on a one-sided cap (fixed direction list) at distance d. d = smallest multiple of 100 bohr where every center-pair impulse component is < 0.5 u in magnitude (static search, recorded).
physics_panel.invariance: for each configuration: all permutations of labels (N <= 4; for N = 9 the 9 cyclic shifts and the reversal), translation by (+3, -2, +5) bohr, and for T: three different summation groupings of the enclosures

metrics: N2: equal to C1-B1 (bit for bit)
label permutation: outputs permute with labels
pair order / grouping: same value (truth) — availability may differ
exact total momentum conservation (sum of dp == 0 per component)
collective survival: |dp_i - a_i| per atom; total lost collective impulse on the far-field center
STOP / REFUSED counts and every counterexample
no_post_hoc_changes: Cases, grids and rules above are fixed before running. Results and counterexamples are reported as found.
